status_definitions.implemented_pending_ci: Implementation and regression evidence exist in the branch; the current revision still needs authoritative CI verification.
status_definitions.not_implemented: The product capability has not been implemented end to end.
status_definitions.intentionally_disabled: The capability remains disabled until the listed license, consent, or deployment gates pass.
status_definitions.not_run: No reproducible benchmark/load run and results are recorded.

gates.scope: Web local analysis performs browser decoding, then runs deterministic DSP in a dedicated module Worker. Semantic labels remain unknown without a model or human review.
limitations: Browser decode still occurs before channel transfer to the Worker.
The UI local path remains limited to 25 MiB and two minutes per track.
No BS.1770/EBU-compliant integrated LUFS, LRA, or true-peak fields are emitted.

gates.scope: Decoded PCM size is checked before PCM channel copies are transferred to the Worker.
limitations: The check runs after browser decoding has allocated its AudioBuffer; it prevents subsequent copies/heavy DSP, not the initial decoder allocation.

gates.scope: Local browser batch is sequential and bounded, with per-track states, IndexedDB persistence, cancel/retry/priority/pause-after-current, partial failures, resuming after source reselection, per-track report inspection, and local ZIP/JSONL/CSV export.
limitations: The batch is browser-local, not a server queue.
An interrupted active item needs the original source file selected again.
Browser storage can be evicted; no durable backup is implied.
A batch accepts at most 20 files and 200 MiB combined, with a 25 MiB per-file and two-minute per-track cap.

gates.scope: Authenticated owner-scoped structured-result save/list/detail/paginated-read/delete routes and a PostgreSQL migration exist. Batch UI can save each completed report separately using a persisted idempotency UUID; save requests omit raw source audio.
limitations: The database migration and API require configured authentication/database deployment.
Client SHA-256 remains unverified by the server.
Real PostgreSQL concurrency/fault-injection tests are not recorded here.

gates.scope: A separate, opt-in FFmpeg processor operation runs the ebur128 filter with sample+true peak modes for one selected upload and returns a versioned report with integrated LUFS, LRA, sample peak, true peak, processor-calculated source SHA-256 and response checksum. It is not mixed into the local env.music-analysis.v2 RMS-proxy fields.
gates.limitation: No current-revision reference-fixture verification of ITU-R BS.1770-5 / EBU R 128 integrated loudness, gating, loudness range, or oversampled true peak.
gates.next_action: Run current-revision CI and the processor's synthetic reference-tone integration test. Before any broadcast-compliance claim, validate official licensed reference sequences and exact-build licensing, and verify the configured production processor exposes ebur128.
limitations: The UI requires a separate unchecked-by-default consent checkbox and explicit meter action; ordinary local analysis/batch processing does not upload audio.
The processor path supports one file per report, is limited to 15 minutes, and is bounded by the configured processor request/upload byte limit. The default same-origin gateway is limited to 4 MiB.

The regression suite includes a synthetic 1 kHz tone with a numeric LUFS tolerance, but the full official ITU-R BS.1770 / EBU R 128 reference-sequence suite, inter-sample peak cases, silence/gating edge cases and representative multichannel sequences have not been run.
The actual deployed FFmpeg build identity/license/configuration and processor availability still require deployment-level verification. This meter operation is not a durable background job.

gates.scope: No deployed durable Music Analyzer worker queue with persisted job state, leases/heartbeats, retries, crash recovery or worker process is in place.
gates.limitation: The existing FFmpeg processor is bounded request processing and per-process admission control, not a durable DSP queue.
gates.next_action: Integrate a maintained PostgreSQL-backed queue (evaluate pg-boss first), add atomic enqueue/outbox/idempotency, a separately deployed worker, heartbeats/fencing, authenticated job APIs, backpressure and real PostgreSQL fault tests.

gates.scope: The product does not upload original audio for Music Analyzer processing or store it in private object storage.
gates.limitation: There is no configured Analyzer-specific object-storage provider/lifecycle, short-lived scoped URLs, retention/expiry reconciler or verified deletion path.
gates.next_action: Design explicit-consent upload, generated opaque object IDs, private encrypted object storage, scoped signed access, retention/deletion cleanup and object ownership checks before enabling cloud audio processing.

gates.scope: Browser SHA-256 identifies the exact selected bytes locally; private dataset records mark that hash unverified.
gates.limitation: No uploaded/processed source audio is currently hashed authoritatively by a backend worker.
gates.next_action: Compute SHA-256 on actual private uploaded bytes in the authorized server processing path and include the verified hash in run provenance; never treat client hashes as verification.

gates.scope: Native Android/iOS single-file WAV Analyzer paths exist; the new Web batch dashboard and cloud library controls are not native batch implementations.
gates.limitation: No separate native Android/iOS batch UX, background-policy behavior, device-resume workflow or native cloud dataset-library UX is verified.
gates.next_action: Implement platform-native batches with each OS's actual lifecycle/background constraints and test independently on emulators/simulators and physical devices.

gates.scope: Local batch exports contain a manifest and one structured result per completed track; cloud bulk export and run comparisons are not implemented.
gates.limitation: No durable background cloud export job, short-lived owner-scoped download URL, checksum manifest verification, or compatible-run comparison is present.
gates.next_action: Add owner-scoped durable export jobs for JSON/JSONL/CSV/ZIP and comparison semantics that reject unlike measurement definitions unless explicitly labeled.

gates.scope: Genre, sub-style, language, mood, instrument and vocal labels remain unknown in the local no-model analyzer unless human supplied/reviewed.
gates.limitation: No licensed representative semantic benchmark has been run; accuracy for Afrobeats/Afro-pop, Yoruba singing or Nigerian Pidgin singing is not established.
gates.next_action: Approve the precise code/weight/data licenses, create a legally usable human-annotated benchmark, report per-class quality/calibration/abstention and add an explicit consented model path only after release thresholds pass.

gates.scope: No 10,000-row/job metadata load test or licensed full-audio throughput benchmark result is recorded.
gates.limitation: Unit tests over batch states are not a 10,000-job load test, and metadata rows do not stand in for actual full-track DSP throughput.
gates.next_action: Run 10,000 job metadata/concurrency/fairness/restart tests against real PostgreSQL and separately benchmark real audio duration/bytes, concurrency, RSS, throughput and failure recovery.

gates.scope: The UI has a separate opt-in for the non-AI remote FFmpeg loudness report. Consent is unchecked by default, the action requires explicit consent in UI and handler, upload starts only after the user activates the meter, and file-change/unmount/cancel aborts the request.
limitations: This consent and explicit user action protects the web UI entry point; production deployment URL/authentication configuration and service/operator retention still require deployment/security review.

Processor inputs are written to temporary per-request files and removed by the processor's cleanup path. No durable private source-audio object storage or authenticated durable DSP-job lifecycle is included.
gates.next_action: Verify the deployed endpoint is correctly secured and configured; test consent cancellation/upload behavior in a live browser, including 4 MiB gateway and unavailable-processor paths.
